```{r}
zes <- c("IL1B","IL6","TNF","IL18","IFNG","CXCL8")

annot %>%
  filter(protein %in% zes) %>%
  select(protein, olink_id, panel, pct_below_lod, pct_missing,
         same_assay_as, duplicate_olink_id) %>%
  arrange(protein, panel)

annot %>%
  filter(assay == "IL6")
annot %>%
  filter(assay == "IL1B")
annot %>%
  filter(assay == "TNF")

annot %>%

annot %>%
```

```{r}
gekozen <- annot %>%
  filter(panel == "Inflammation" & assay == "IL6" | assay == "IL1B" | assay == "TNF" | assay == "IL18" | assay == "IFNG" | assay == "CXCL8")

#is hetzelfde als:
gekozen <- annot %>%
  filter(
    panel == "Inflammation",
    assay %in% c("IL6", "IL1B", "TNF", "IL18", "IFNG", "CXCL8")
  )

gekozen %>%
  select(protein, assay, panel, pct_below_lod, pct_missing)
```
